title: Jungle Expedition

reviewPolicy.reason: Player visual judgment remains authoritative. Pass 13 deepens the procedural daylight-to-storm-to-sunbreak cycle, adds weighted one-to-five lightning events, and makes every amber practical respond naturally to storm darkness while preserving all Pass 12 residents and earlier world systems.

practicalLightNetwork.respondingMaterial: shared amber lantern, torch, beacon, and lit-interior material

viteProductionBuild.notes: Existing mixed static/dynamic import and large chunk warnings remain; the production bundle completed successfully.

implementedVisualSystems: the clear-rest and clear-recovery phases now use a lighter cyan-blue procedural dome gradient, with no image-mapped sky or 2D weather asset
cloud gathering progressively lowers and darkens the cloud depth sectors before the rain begins, while the procedural canopy and primary world lights dim with the same weather exposure
each 180-second storm deterministically selects one to five lightning events from an authored weighted distribution; one or two events own 79 percent of the probability mass
lightning origins shift across the sky per event and briefly illuminate the dome, clouds, hemisphere, key light, turquoise bounce, and rain-line bolt together
nine solid 3D halo volumes batch into one InstancedMesh around the temple and landmark practicals
up to four short-range, no-shadow warm light pools illuminate the Explorer Nest, Jungle Path, Explorer's Camp, and Survival Trials according to the active mobile quality profile
the shared amber material for lanterns, torches, beacons, doors, and lit interiors strengthens only after the mission emissive choreography has run, so weather never overwrites Emerald Zenith
multi-frequency flame flicker is restrained in daylight, gains warmth and local spill in storm darkness, and settles to a stable pose in reduced-motion mode
post-rain sun shafts open gradually before the light-blue sky returns, followed by a long calm interval before cloud gathering starts the cycle again
canvas QA telemetry exposes phase, storm cycle, selected flash count, practical-light exposure, and daylight-blue strength without adding gameplay authority

evidence.proves: the long calm phase reads as open cyan-blue daylight over the layered jungle and resident promenade
the full storm materially darkens the sky, temple, canopy, and water while warm lantern, doorway, beacon, and torch accents remain readable
the deterministic rare five-event cycle captures an active displaced bolt and its synchronized world-light flash
the phone-only crop keeps the warm temple windows, torches, beacons, and landmark pools readable against the dark storm canopy
warm volumetric sun lines return gradually across the wet jungle before the clear blue recovery

knownCaptureNotes: The source image remains a visual reference only and is not rendered in Island 018.
The captures retain the real workbench chrome because they verify the production narrow-phone authoring surface and its 7/7 release gate.
Pass 13 inherits Pass 12 resident evidence and the complete Pass 11 pack for landmarks, tunnels, construction, wildlife, water, and Emerald Zenith.
The active 10/10 production goal remains open until player visual judgment validates the island.
